description: This file is a header (.h) file defining the interface for 'Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_RouteHops' APIs related to TR-069 device IP diagnostics. It declares functions to retrieve information about trace route hops such as host, host address, error code, and RTTimes.

methods.name: get_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_RouteHops_Host
methods.description: Retrieves the host name or IP address of a hop along the route, resolving DNS if possible.

methods.name: get_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_RouteHops_HostAddress
methods.description: Provides the last IP address of the host returned for a specific hop, which may be an empty string.

methods.name: get_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_RouteHops_ErrorCode
methods.description: Provides the ICMP error code returned for this hop.

methods.name: get_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_RouteHops_RTTimes
methods.description: Provides a list of round-trip times in milliseconds for this hop.
